title: 抽象ループ型のスプリング遊具
description: 公園や遊び場に置く1人用スプリング遊具のオリジナル抽象デザイン。動物や既存キャラクターを模していない流線形本体、開いた楕円ループ、座席、両側グリップ・足掛け、コイルばね、上下フランジと接地固定板を造形。子供、地面や落下保護舗装は含みません。装飾用の静的モデルで、ばね挙動・耐荷重・挟み込み・遊具安全規格は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.883 × 1.135 × 0.590 m、18,508三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An original single-seat spring rider for park and playground scenes: an abstract swoosh body and open oval loop, not an animal or an existing character, with a saddle, paired grips and footrests, helical spring, mounting flanges and ground anchor plate. No child, ground or impact-absorbing surfacing. Decorative static geometry; spring behavior, load capacity, entrapment and playground safety standards are not validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.883 × 1.135 × 0.590 m; 18,508 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
